Following the clues from her letter, you head to the Skyworks in the Western Fang Peaks for more answers. Liangyu joins you, determined to find out why the Autopuppets went rogue. To investigate, you have Abby consume an Autopuppet's kernel. Surprisingly, beyond the original data and frequency, the kernel is warped with intense negative emotions. Following Yangyang's trail deep into the Skyworks, you find a destroyed Cloud Ride and her hat. Just as you plan your next move, you cross paths with Muyu, who is attempting to flee the facility. He reveals that Yangyang is in grave danger. Enraged, you move to apprehend him, but he escapes into the depths of the Skyworks. As you pursue Muyu, you rescue Uncle Dong, who was kidnapped and brought to Xuanfang. He tells you and Liangyu that all the missing citizens from Jinzhou have been imprisoned in the Skyworks by unidentified thugs. Muyu uses the remaining hostages to escape. Meanwhile, a massive Autopuppet emerges from the depths of the Skyworks to block your way. After defeating the Myriad Snare, Yangyang collapses from exhaustion. You wait by her side until she awakens. She initially thinks your presence is an illusion, but you assure her that you are truly there. With the mastermind unmasked, you tell Yangyang that Suisui is also in the Land of Xuanfang. The three of you decide to return to Xuanfang Hold to regroup. (Suisui's Point of View) While exploring, Suisui tries to bypass the Disorienting Fog but is suddenly surrounded by rogue Autopuppets. Suddenly, a mysterious voice from within the fog catches her attention. With no other way out, Suisui follows the voice and steps into the fog. After clearing the fog, Suisui meets the source of the voice—"Cat of the Nether Lamp." He is an informant Suisui had hired before even knowing Yangyang was missing, proving she had planned to come to Xuanfang all along. After exchanging intelligence with him, Suisui heads to Fogveil Pagoda to fulfill a prior promise. Deep within the pagoda's hidden Sonoro Sphere, Suisui meets a frequency of Hsin the Moon Fox, Mengzhou's Sentinel, whom she had made a secret deal with. Desperate to save Yangyang, Suisui tries to alter their pact to use the Sentinel's token for her sister's rescue. For breaking the deal, Hsin strips Suisui of her status as a chosen partner. Relying on the frequency Jinhsi has entrusted to her, Suisui manages to remain in the Sonoro Sphere and pushes deeper to persuade the Sentinel. After a tense pursuit, Suisui nears the Sentinel's token. But just as she is about to seize it, the layout of the Sonoro Sphere begins to change again. Hsin the Moon Fox projects a reality-based deduction of the current world crisis to make Suisui understand Her concerns. At the critical moment, Suisui invokes your name to change Hsin's mind. Moved by her resolve, Hsin agrees to a final wager to settle the matter. Suisui secures the Sentinel's token and leaves the pagoda. Sensing a sudden anomaly erupting from the Western Fang Peaks, she asks Dumpling to deliver the token directly to your hands. (Completing both Rover Line and Suisui Line) Back in Xuanfang Hold, you and Yangyang reunite with Suisui. After a brief greeting, Suisui apologizes for having kept things from you and recounts her experience after you were separated in the fog. You, Yangyang, and Suisui exchange the intel you have gathered. Piecing the clues together, Suisui believes that Zhuojun Atelier, a prominent Automata Mechanics organization based in Mengzhou, is heavily implicated. To gather more evidence, you seek out the Warden Commander and Liangyu. According to the Warden Commander, the Court of Savantae was the last faction involved in building Xuanfang Hold two centuries ago. But regardless of the mysteries weaving these events together, you must brace yourselves for an imminent siege. Communication across Xuanfang has been severed by unknown interference. Fortunately, the Ministry of Development has just finished a batch of signal nodes. Once we place them around the Hold, they will restore our internal comms and link directly to the defense systems. In the Hold, you and Yangyang meet the chief of Xianling Village and return the longsword to him. But as you place the sword back onto the altar, a familiar song echoes behind you, pulling you and Yangyang into a Sonoro Sphere. Inside the Sonoro Sphere, you see the memories of Lingfang, Liangyu's ancestor from two hundred years ago. Her husband had been killed by Tacet Discords, and she was about to march onto the battlefield. Before departing, she sang the familiar song once more as a thank-you to Yangyang for comforting her. The tide of battle turns when Qingxiao, the Xuan Paragon previously held captive in a Censure Court, breaks free to reinforce the front lines. Just then, an anomaly erupts from a nearby court. After a brief discussion, you and Yangyang head into the court to face the one behind the crisis: Muyu. As you step into the malfunctioning Censure Court, a mysterious silhouette manifests before Yangyang. Addressing her as the "Votary of the Voice," the figure warns her to turn back, stating that continuing down this path means embarking on a point of no return, one that demands she give up everything. Refusing to let you face the danger alone, Yangyang chooses to stand by your side. Deep within the Censure Court, you confront Muyu. He rants about his distrust of Sentinels and his rejection of human emotion, unveiling the truth behind the Autopuppet uprising. Refuting his twisted theory, you and Yangyang face Muyu's creation—the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion, a colossus powered by the Reverberations of countless fallen souls. To stop Muyu, you must shatter this distorted manifestation of his will. After the crisis settles, you meet Suisui in Xuanfang Hold. When asked why she trusted you enough to hand over the Sentinel's token, Suisui smiles, calling it a matter of pure intuition. The Warden Commander puts you and Yangyang on a call with Jinhsi. Driven by your own convictions, the two of you decide to stay in the Land of Xuanfang for now. As the call ends, the Rafter Kite that aided you so many times lands gently beside Yangyang. She thanks it before releasing it back into the sky. The Rafter Kite circles over the Land of Xuanfang for a long time, before descending into a silent, quiet darkness... }} ==Line Review== {{Tabber |Current Day: Noon| Rover and Suisui become separated by the Disorienting Fog.
